description:
Community Service Project Successfully Completed – 4th November 🌟
With the generous support of our donors, Shilpa and Rtn. Ketan Mehta, we successfully served breakfast today to 250 cancer patients and their relatives staying at Gadge Maharaj.
🙏 Heartfelt gratitude to Shilpa and Rtn. Ketan Mehta for their kindness, compassion, and generous contribution towards making this meaningful initiative a success.
A special thanks to Rtn. Pankaj Vora, Rtn. Arun Gada, Rtn. Devanshi Dave, Rtn. Ketan, Shilpa, and Monish Mehta for their valuable support and gracious presence.
Together, through small acts of kindness, we can make a meaningful difference in the lives of those in need.
❤️ Service Above Self!
